case_number: 2025 INSC 169; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C) NO.16423 of 2021)
summary: Appointment of LPG distributor; fraud in domicile certificate; eligibility based on residency; failure to serve notice on appellant in second appeal; non-framing of substantial questions of law under Section 100 CPC; review petition dismissed as barred by Order 47 Rule 9 CPC; RTI revelation of forged documents; challenge to finality of High Court judgment; procedural compliance in appellate and review proceedings.
legal_provisions_cited: Order 47 Rule 9 Code of Civil Procedure
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order dated 05.01.2021 set aside; High Court directed to reconsider review application on merits.
